name: Mounier-Kühn syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Radiologic and clinical diagnostic criteria for Mounier-Kühn syndrome

criteria.description: Tracheal diameter exceeding 3 cm on chest imaging
Dilation of main bronchi exceeding normal diameter thresholds
History of recurrent lower respiratory tract infections
Obstructive or mixed ventilatory defects on pulmonary function tests

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of tracheal dilation and bronchial dilation on imaging plus clinical features consistent with recurrent respiratory infections
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily radiologic supported by clinical history; genetic testing is not routinely available.

laboratory: Non-specific inflammatory markers may be elevated during infections
imaging: Chest X-ray showing widened tracheal shadow
CT scan demonstrating tracheobronchomegaly and bronchiectasis
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; presumed congenital connective tissue defect
other: Pulmonary function tests showing obstructive or mixed ventilatory defects

distinguishingFeatures: Usually secondary to infections or cystic fibrosis
Inflammation of cartilaginous structures including ears and nose
Systemic autoimmune features absent in Mounier-Kühn syndrome

references: Mounier-Kühn syndrome: clinical and radiologic features. Eur Respir J. 2019.
Orphanet: Mounier-Kühn syndrome. Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases, 2020.
Pulmonary manifestations of Mounier-Kühn syndrome. Chest. 2018.
